versions.changelog: Recovery messages now send you to the newsroom you configured: with NEWS_SITE set, the no-key, 401 and check messages name that site's key page instead of alaskanews.com. A test holds every message to it.

Says what it writes on your machine: only brief --out FILE, a Markdown file at the path you give, replacing one already there. Read-only toward the newsroom, as before; behaviour unchanged, and a test holds the client to that one write.
digest --date asks the newsroom's feed for exactly one day, in the time zone the newsroom reports: faster, complete for any date, no key. Built on the platform's feed fix of 2026-09-30.

digest --date: one day's stories with a summary each, no key. brief: a research brief before writing (prior coverage, transcripts, people, events, then four blanks). Clearer guidance: matching coverage is relevant, not corroborated; a read-only key cannot write but is still a credential; rag needs a key that can POST.
Housekeeping: a code comment now points at the newsroom's public API spec instead of an internal planning document. No behaviour changes.

Renamed to local-news-api (Local News API); news-desk redirects here. The key is now COMMUNITIES_NEWS_API_KEY; NEWS_DESK_API_KEY and ALASKA_DESK_API_KEY still work. SKILL.md uses Alaska News as its worked example: https://alaskanews.com and https://alaskanews.com/api/v1.

Security fix: a .env in the directory the skill runs from can no longer set NEWS_SITE or PLATFORM_API_BASE, so a project cannot choose where your API key is sent. It may still supply the key. Found by ClawHub's scan of 1.3.0.

First ClawHub release. Read-only local news API client for Communities News newsrooms (live for Alaska News): search articles, their sources, public meeting transcripts and upcoming events. digest, topics and tags need no key.
